name: Fine-Grained Accessor for Tables
description: Provides row- and column-level access control for tabular datasets through a query rewrite layer that injects tenant predicates and column masks based on the caller's identity and policies.
when_to_use: Database or warehouse lacks native row-level security
Multiple personas share a table with different visibility
GDPR/PII masking required at query time
benefits: Works across databases without native RLS
drawbacks: Risk of policy bypass if optimizer rewrites
use_cases: PII column masking in BI tools
